title: Small Business Saturday - Small Business Administration

facts.fact: Small Business Saturday falls on November 28, 2026, according to the SBA page.
facts.quote: Champion small businesses nationwide and #ShopSmall on Saturday, November 28, 2026.

facts.fact: Small Business Saturday was founded by American Express in 2010.
facts.quote: Small Business Saturday was founded by American Express in 2010 and officially cosponsored by SBA since 2011.

facts.fact: SBA has officially cosponsored Small Business Saturday since 2011.
The SBA Million Dollar Pitch Competition has five small business owners competing for a share of $1 million in cash prizes.
facts.quote: Five small business owners battle for a share of $1 million in cash prizes.

facts.fact: The SBA cosponsorship authorization number for this activity is #26-33-C.
